scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npx concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
